# Who responded to the FY26 annual appeal?

The fall 2025 annual appeal was mailed to about 1,100 households — nearly all of them
prior donors. A household **responded** if anyone in it gave a SUCCEEDED gift to the
*Annual Fund Drive - 2025-2026* campaign between October 1, 2025 and January 31, 2026.
Giving and engagement are counted the same way as everywhere in this book: rolled up to
the household, with engagement measured only for events that had happened before the
appeal mailed (see [Methodology](99-methodology.html)).

```{python}
#| label: setup-appeal
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from hh.analytics.appeal import response_summary
from hh.analytics.donors import TIER_LABELS
from hh.io import read_parquet
from hh.viz import fmt_gift, money, pct, style, SEQUENTIAL_BLUE

t = read_parquet("processed", "appeal_households.parquet")
ap = t[t["appealed"]].copy()
n_universe = len(t)
n_appealed = len(ap)
n_responded = int(ap["responded"].sum())
resp_rate = n_responded / n_appealed
responder_gifts = ap.loc[ap["responded"], "afd_amount"]
resp_dollars = responder_gifts.sum()
median_gift = responder_gifts.median()
campaign_total = t["afd_amount"].sum()

not_appealed = t[~t["appealed"]]
n_not_appealed = len(not_appealed)
prior_donor_share_appealed = ap["prior_donor"].mean()
prior_donor_share_not = not_appealed["prior_donor"].mean()
arts_share_not = (not_appealed["eng_n_performance"] > 0).mean()
class_share_not = (not_appealed["eng_n_class"] > 0).mean()


def _fmt(raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return raw.rename(
        columns={
            "households": "Households", "responded": "Gave", "rate": "Response rate",
            "dollars": "Total $", "avg_gift": "Avg gift", "median_gift": "Median gift",
        }
    ).assign(
        **{
            "Response rate": lambda d: d["Response rate"].map(pct),
            "Total $": lambda d: d["Total $"].map(money),
            "Avg gift": lambda d: fmt_gift(d["Avg gift"]),
            "Median gift": lambda d: fmt_gift(d["Median gift"]),
        }
    )


def display_summary(df, by, order=None, total=True):
    """response_summary for display, with a totals row (overall rate, responder-level
    avg/median — not averages of the group rows)."""
    raw = response_summary(df, by).set_index(by)
    if order is not None:
        raw = raw.reindex(order)
    parts = [_fmt(raw.reset_index())]
    if total:
        grand = response_summary(df.assign(**{"_total": "Total"}), "_total")
        parts.append(_fmt(grand.rename(columns={"_total": by})))
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
```

**`{python} f"{n_responded:,}"` of `{python} f"{n_appealed:,}"` appealed households
responded (`{python} pct(resp_rate)`)**, giving
`{python} money(resp_dollars)` of the
`{python} money(campaign_total)` donated to the campaign during the window. The median
responding household gave `{python} money(median_gift)`.

## Response by prior giving

Prior giving is each household's lifetime total before October 1, 2025, in the same
four tiers as [Are large donors going away?](07-donor-persistence.html).

```{python}
#| label: fig-appeal-tier
#| fig-cap: "Response rate by prior-lifetime-giving tier"
ap["prior tier"] = ap["prior_size_tier"].fillna("never gave")
tier_order = TIER_LABELS + ["never gave"]
by_tier = response_summary(ap, "prior tier").set_index("prior tier").reindex(tier_order)

fig = px.bar(by_tier.reset_index(), x="prior tier", y="rate")
fig.update_traces(
    texttemplate=[pct(r) for r in by_tier["rate"]], textposition="outside",
    marker_color=SEQUENTIAL_BLUE[7],
)
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Prior lifetime giving", yaxis_title="Share of households that responded",
    yaxis_tickformat=".0%",
)
style(fig).show()
```

```{python}
display_summary(ap, "prior tier", order=tier_order)
```

## Response by giving recency

```{python}
# a true partition of the appealed households (lapsed donors are a subset of
# "not in FY25", so the middle row excludes them to keep the groups disjoint)
groups = [
    ("gave in FY25 (year before appeal)", ap["prior_fy_donor"].fillna(False)),
    (
        "gave within 24 months, before FY25",
        ap["prior_donor"] & ~ap["prior_fy_donor"].fillna(False) & ~ap["lapsed_donor"].fillna(False),
    ),
    ("lapsed 24+ months", ap["lapsed_donor"].fillna(False)),
    ("never gave", ~ap["prior_donor"].fillna(False)),
]
status = pd.concat([ap[m].assign(**{"giving status": label}) for label, m in groups])
display_summary(status, "giving status", order=[g[0] for g in groups])
```

## Response by engagement before the appeal

Engagement profiles count only events that **started** by September 30, 2025 —
registering in September for a November show does not count.

```{python}
profile_order = ["arts+class", "arts", "class", "community/other", "none"]
display_summary(ap, "eng_profile", order=profile_order)
```

## Response by distance from the Hall

```{python}
BAND_LABELS = {
    "[0, 1)": "0–1 mi", "[1, 5)": "1–5 mi", "[5, 10)": "5–10 mi",
    "[10, 20)": "10–20 mi", "[20, ∞)": "20+ mi",
}
ap["miles"] = ap["distance_band"].map(BAND_LABELS)
display_summary(ap, "miles", order=list(BAND_LABELS.values()))
```

## Households that were not appealed

Of the `{python} f"{n_universe:,}"` households in the database,
`{python} f"{n_not_appealed:,}"` were not appealed. The mailing list was
overwhelmingly the donor file:
`{python} pct(prior_donor_share_appealed)` of appealed households had given before,
versus `{python} pct(prior_donor_share_not)` of those not appealed. Among the
not-appealed, `{python} pct(arts_share_not)` had attended performances and
`{python} pct(class_share_not)` had taken classes before the appeal.
